title: Minkah Fitzpatrick, five others fined for player safety fouls in Week 6

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Minkah Fitzpatrick, five others fined for player safety fouls in Week 6
sources.description: The NFL confirmed that Jets safety Minkah Fitzpatrick was fined for his hit on a defenseless KC Concepcion in the Jets' Week 5 win over the Browns and they announced five other players were fined for the player safety fouls that count toward potential suspensions.
